changelog:
session-name-sync v1.0.0

- Initial release of session-name-sync.
- Bidirectional sync of session names between Claude Code (CLI/VSCode) and cc-connect naming systems.
- Supports modes: set, sync, list, bind, and register, covering major workflows for naming sessions.
- Provides comparison, synchronization, and registration of session names across both storage systems.
- Optimizes registration to cc-connect, avoiding unnecessary daemon restarts.
- Includes clear trigger phrases and usage instructions for interactive and scripted use.
summary: Bidirectionally sync session names between Claude Code (CLI/VSCode) and cc-connect. Three naming systems share two storage locations: Claude Code CLI /rename...
